text_block_list.text:
A fan letter arrived
for Silence Suzuka, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A letter, you say?
Ah... It's from an Umamusume girl, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Thanks to everyone's support,
there are races I'm able to run in, after all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Still, it feels a little strange.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"People often tell me that they love
how good my running looks and feels, but—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't just sitting and watching
make you feel all restless...?
choice_data_list: It's because Suzuka is running so beautifully
It's because Suzuka is running so beautifully!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So that's how it works.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Then... I have decided
to just keep running forward, as I always have.
Silence Suzuka had seemed confused, but in her own way, she appeared to be mindful of her fans.
